summary: Lincoln County, OR site: a 1950 lookout tower staffed to 1953, a 1957 trailer gone in the 1960s; no source describes what remains today.

facts.design: 20-foot lookout tower with fire finder and telephone service (1950); a trailer set up on the site in 1957
facts.status_note: The trailer was gone in the 1960s per the register and firelookout.com; no source describes what remains

corrections.why: The record shows only the 1957 trailer; the Lincoln FPA reports quoted on the Forest Lookouts page describe a 20-foot lookout tower in 1950 and staffing in 1951 to 1953.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page header gives 8S-9W-14 (section 14), but the 1950 report quoted on the same page places the camp in section 10 T8S R9W. The story does not rely on either section number.

sources.title: Suncrest Point Lookout Site

notes_for_editor: No source describes the site today, so no access fact is recorded. The 1949 to 1953 entries come from Lincoln FPA annual reports quoted on the Forest Lookouts page; the 1949 and 1950 reports do not name Suncrest (the 1951 to 1953 entries do), so the link for those two years rests on the page. The 1957 trailer and 1960s removal rest on the register and firelookout.com, which repeat the same two facts. The 1950 section number does not match the page header legal.
